columns.user_id: INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.title: TEXT NOT NULL

boards.notes: UNIQUE on user_id enforces one board per user in the MVP; drop it to allow several.

columns.board_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES boards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.title: TEXT NOT NULL

columns.notes: Five rows per board, created with the board. Only title changes.

columns.column_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES columns(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.title: TEXT NOT NULL
columns.label: TEXT

indexes: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cards_column ON cards(column_id, position)
cards.notes: position is 0..n-1 within a column, rewritten on every insert, move and delete. due_date is 'YYYY-MM-DD'; priority is low|medium|high; label is red|orange|yellow|green|blue|purple; assignee is free text (max 50). All four are optional (NULL) and are added to older databases at startup.

api_board_shape.description: GET /api/board and the AI prompt use the frontend BoardState shape. Database ids are exposed as prefixed strings so column and card ids never collide.
